item: atomic_replace dead-temp sweep: a fresh copy is never swept, and an own-pid predecessor's copy is (R287 L1+L2)
summary: sweep_dead_temps judged a copy's owner by bare pid, so a live writer in another pid namespace or on a NAS peer lost its in-flight copy, and a copy stranded under the process's own pid was never swept. Now a copy younger than SWEEP_MIN_AGE_S=3600 s is kept (write-to-swap measured as max_swap_s: 0.35 s for 256 MiB), and an own-pid copy older than this process is removed; clock-skew, clock-step and stopped-writer limits stated.
